name: Jacobio Pharmaceuticals Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jacobio Pharmaceuticals Group Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the in-house discovery and development of oncology therapies in the People's Republic of China. The company develops sitneprotafib (JAB-3312), an oral allosteric SHP2 inhibitor that is in a Phase III trial for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC); glecirasib (JAB-21822), a KRAS G12C allosteric inhibitor in Phase II trials for NSCLC, multi-tumor basket, and colorectal cancer; JAB-8263, a BET inhibitor that is in a Phase IIa trial for solid tumors and hematologic malignancies; JAB-BX102, a humanized monoclonal antibody against CD73, which is in a Phase I/IIa trial; JAB-2485, a highly selective Aurora Kinase A (AUR…
